name: Sanseki
source:
Bilboa the female assassin fell in love with Tiffany the nun while in prison. Love, however, is a euphemism for a darker carnal feeling...

An erotic sapphic novel with a dark ambiance.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ138999.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]

这是一部氛围阴暗的色情女同小说。
